answer: Verified Compute Tenure. Each identity must complete sustained useful work—audited inference jobs or validated data labeling—held continuously for a fixed window before gaining full economic rights. A hollow account that merely registers accrues nothing. Enforcement: rights decay in a rolling tide, so idle or low-quality agents lose standing automatically. The per-identity cost is real compute, labor, and time, creating a haven where mass fake registration fails because each fake must independently sustain verified output.
